items.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
items.overview: A háború utáni Japán romjai között a múlt sebei tovább gyógyulnak, amikor ismét felbukkan a pusztító Godzilla, és az embereknek ezúttal is szembe kell nézniük a túlélés, a gyász és az újjáépítés könyörtelen próbájával, miközben egy maroknyi túlélőnek mindent felül kell vizsgálnia, amit a reményről és az önfeláldozásról gondolt.

items.title: Club Kid
items.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

items.title: Rammstein: Live in Mexico City
items.overview: A three-night compilation that captures their spectacular October 2022 shows at the Foro Sol Stadium in Mexico City during the Stadium Tour era. This live has become the band's most massive and longest one of their entire career.

items.title: Ninho: Le Prix à payer
items.overview: Ninho's intense, decade-long career and the immense personal sacrifices that come with being France's most-streamed artist. The documentary offers a unique behind-the-scenes look as he wants to stepping away from the spotlight entirely.

items.title: Nos âmes libres
items.overview: An odyssey towards the self, an invitation to rediscover sensitivity. It is a journey through time, countries, and elements – water, earth, mountains, form – an expedition that intimately explores, without judgment or taboo, the relationship humans maintain with other species, as well as the awareness we have of ourselves and of our planet.

items.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
items.overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

items.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
items.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

items.title: On Behalf of My Son
items.overview: At 75, Vicentina faces the death of her son, a bus driver who caused a tragedy by plunging off a viaduct. As the investigation suggests possible suicide, she seeks out the victims' families to offer her apologies.

items.title: Kalapos Macska
items.overview: A Macskát eddigi legnehezebb küldetésével bízzák meg... hogy segítsen két testvérnek, akiknek nehézséget okoz a beilleszkedés egy új városban.  (Csillag Lajos)

items.title: The Invisible Guest
items.overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

items.title: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
items.overview: “UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun” follows the world-renowned classical Chinese dance company Shen Yun Performing Arts as it rises to global acclaim while facing intimidation and threats of violence. Through the eyes of two brothers and their fellow performers, the film traces an unlikely journey—from ordinary American childhoods to the world’s most prestigious stages—where rigorous artistic training and spiritual conviction shape both their craft and their character.  As Shen Yun tours internationally, the company becomes the target of escalating smear campaigns, threats, and alleged interference linked to the Chinese Communist Party. Blending personal storytelling with investigative reporting, “UNBROKEN” reveals what happens when art, faith, and freedom collide with totalitarianism power—and how resilience, community, and cultural revival endure in the face of intimidation.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in Texas
items.overview: When a man searching for his missing brother uncovers that a dime-novel Western is actually a true account of cursed events that shaped the American frontier, he's pulled into a brutal chain of betrayals, gunfights, and legends.

items.title: See You Tomorrow Tomorrow Tomorrow
items.overview: An aspiring, queer stand-up comedian grapples with her career and the greater duty of caring for her 99-year-old grandmother in her final years.

items.title: Drummer Boy
items.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family each search for freedom in a world built to deny it. With music carrying hope through battle and loss, Drummer Boy turns the Revolution into a deeply human story of faith, forgiveness, and the belief that no person is born to live in chains or be forgotten.

items.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
items.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

items.title: Chocolate for Christmas
items.overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.

items.title: Being Heumann
items.overview: A harcias, dacos Judy Heumann megelégeli, hogy teherként kezelik, és forradalommá formálja dühét. 1977-ben több mint 100, a fogyatékosok jogaiért harcoló társával a világba kiáltják üzenetüket: A rendszer a rokkant, nem mi.

items.title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
items.overview: In 2015, alleged thieves left Isabel Fuentes near death in her own home. This documentary traces how suspicions quickly fell on her circle of trust.

items.title: Mouse
items.overview: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.
